column1: # Nuclear Option (Steam 2168680) Rewired actions of Player0, see research.md.

# id = the game's own Rewired action name (the string the game code passes to player.GetButton/GetAxis; source: the action names community mods use, e.g. PauelsRandomFixes/HeliBinds; since 0.34.2 refresh-db reads them from the installed resources.assets).

# <Action>.Positive / <Action>.Negative = a button on one pole of an axis action (ActionElementMap elementType=1, axisContribution 0/1); title = the pole name the game shows (nuclearoption.wiki.gg Controls page).
# The numeric Rewired action ids (actionId in the saved XML) are NOT public; resolve name -> id from the install (research.md "Action ids").
# Pole signs (which wiki row is Positive) are inferred from the game code; rows marked (?) in the title are unverified.
# Categories = tabs of the in-game Control Bindings Menu. JoyPro clean/nuke may only touch "Flight Controls" rows.

column2: Axis Modifier (hold: throttle input drives Custom Axis 1)
Target Select (mark unit at camera centre; also map click)
Target Cancel (press: deselect last, hold: deselect all)
Toggle Flight Assist (press: stability assist / auto tilt, hold: auto-hover)
Move Vertical (free camera; cockpit camera elevation since 0.34)
Jump camera to map cursor (map, not flying)
